    ```{r}


    library(readxl)
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(gridExtra)

    experience <- read_excel("C:/Users/wdnmd/Desktop/fyp/经历组.xlsx") %>% slice(-1)
    internal <- read_excel("C:/Users/wdnmd/Desktop/fyp/内化组.xlsx") %>% slice(-1)

    calc_scores <- function(df){
      df %>% 
        mutate(
          Muscularity_Dissatisfaction = rowMeans(select(., `我觉得我的身体太小`, `我觉得我的胸肌太小`, 
                               `我觉得我的手臂不够粗`, `我觉得我的腿太细了`) %>% 
                        mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
          Drive_for_Muscularity = rowMeans(select(., `我希望自己的肌肉更发达`, `肌肉更发达我会感觉更自信`,
                               `我觉得我的手臂肌肉不够发达`, `我觉得我的胸肌不够发达`) %>% 
                        mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
          Muscularity_Bias_Internalization = rowMeans(select(., `如果我的肌肉不够明显，我会觉得自己一无是处`,
                               `我会因为自己肌肉不够强壮而讨厌我自己`,
                               `我担心自己肌肉不够明显`) %>% 
                        mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
          Negative_Affect = rowMeans(select(., `害怕的`, `紧张的`, `心烦的`, `心神不宁的`) %>% 
                        mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
          Positive_Affect = rowMeans(select(., `备受鼓舞的`, `热情的`, `精神活力高的`) %>% 
                        mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE),
          SE_reverse = 5 - as.numeric(`归根结底，我倾向于觉得自己是一个失败者`),
          Self_Esteem = rowMeans(select(., `我感到我是一个有价值的人`, `我能像大多数人一样把事情做好`,
                              `我对自己持肯定的态度`, SE_reverse) %>% 
                        mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)
        ) %>% 
        select(Muscularity_Dissatisfaction, Drive_for_Muscularity, 
               Muscularity_Bias_Internalization, Negative_Affect, 
               Positive_Affect, Self_Esteem)
    }

    exp_data <- calc_scores(experience) %>% mutate(Group = "Experience")
    int_data <- calc_scores(internal) %>% mutate(Group = "Internalization")
    plot_data <- rbind(exp_data, int_data)

    # t检验
    vars <- c("Muscularity_Dissatisfaction", "Drive_for_Muscularity", 
              "Muscularity_Bias_Internalization", "Negative_Affect", 
              "Positive_Affect", "Self_Esteem")

    for (v in vars) {
      test <- t.test(plot_data[[v]] ~ plot_data$Group)
      cat("\n", v, ": t =", round(test$statistic,2), 
          ", df =", round(test$parameter,2), 
          ", p =", round(test$p.value,4))
    }

    # 画图
    create_plot <- function(v, title){
      ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=Group, y=.data[[v]], fill=Group)) +
        geom_bar(stat="summary", fun="mean", width=0.6, color="black") +
        geom_errorbar(stat="summary", fun.data=mean_se, width=0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("#4682B4", "#DC143C")) +
        labs(title=title, x="Group", y="Mean") + theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position="none")
    }

    p1 <- create_plot("Muscularity_Dissatisfaction", "Muscularity Dissatisfaction")
    p2 <- create_plot("Drive_for_Muscularity", "Drive for Muscularity")
    p3 <- create_plot("Muscularity_Bias_Internalization", "Muscularity Bias Internalization")
    p4 <- create_plot("Negative_Affect", "Negative Affect")
    p5 <- create_plot("Positive_Affect", "Positive Affect")
    p6 <- create_plot("Self_Esteem", "Self-Esteem")

    grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, nrow=2, ncol=3)


    ```
